title: Bu va u
hook_voice: Lesson twelve. This, that. What is this?
hook_say: Bu va anavi inglizcha qanday bo'ladi?

example.en: What is this? It's a book.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n uchinchi dars: buyumlar.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 12-dars: inglizcha «this» va «that».

This is a book — Bu kitob
That is a car — Anavi mashina
What is this? — Bu nima?

this — yaqindagi narsa, that — uzoqdagi narsa. Javobda: It's a book (It's = It is).
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 13-dars: Buyumlar.
